raw_segments.text: Two days are past. It is a summer evening. The coachman has set me down at a place called Whitcross.
He could take me no farther for the sum I had given, and I was not possessed of another shilling in the world.
The coach is a mile off by this time. I am alone. At this moment
I discover that I forgot to take my parcel out of the pocket of the coach where I had placed it for safety.
There it remains. There it must remain. And now I am absolutely destitute.
